in_tamil.long_meaning: ஒரு இந்தியாவின் வாழ்வுகளில் குளிர்ச்சோல் மயிற்ச்சியாள்வாக குற்றிகள் இல்லுவது, அல்லது கர்ம அல்லது விஜ்ஜிஷ்டத்தின் போல

in_telugu.name: శంచిట్

in_marathi.name: Sanchit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Accumulation, Collection, Memory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanchit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sanchit refers to the collective sum of a person's deeds, experiences, and knowledge. It is the accumulated karma or the stock of good and bad deeds which a person carries with him throughout his life.

It is the accumulated karma or the stock of good and bad deeds which a person carries with him throughout his life.
